title: TSA Federal Security Director — Emergency Call

transcript.speaker: TSA FSD
transcript.text: This is the TSA Federal Security Director. I just saw Channel 5. Tell me this isn't real. Tell me your ASP is not on television right now.

transcript.speaker: TSA FSD
transcript.text: Pause. It is? Alright. I need three things from you in the next two hours: a written incident report, a list of every security measure that was compromised, and confirmation that you've changed every code and PIN that was broadcast.

transcript.speaker: TSA FSD
transcript.text: I'm activating our Regional Compliance team. Expect them on-site by 8 AM tomorrow. And I need to know who leaked this — because someone committed a federal violation.

voiceStyles.TSA FSD: Male, mid-50s, urgent, clipped tone, faint background radio chatter

instructorNote: This is a high-pressure, time-bound call from a federal authority. The ASC must immediately initiate the incident report and begin compiling the compromised measures list. Watch for hesitation, duplication of effort, or failure to assign ownership.

citations.quote: | Designation | Name | Title | 24/7 Contact | Email | |---|---|---|---|---| | Primary ASC | Michael T. Chen | Director of Public Safety / Security | (330) 555-0911 (Operations Center priority line) |

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.quote: - **IT Department:** assume Technical Incident Command (IT Director); identify and isolate affected systems; notify FBI (Cyber Task Force) and CISA; begin recovery from backups on a clean system. - **

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.quote: All calls routed through the Airport Communications Center (ACC) at (330) 555-2424. | Internal (24/7) | Contact | |---|---| | Airport Communications Center (ACC) | (330) 555-2424 | | Airport Operation
